samples.question: The picture is a pale instrument sheet. Exactly one object on the sheet is a core button: a small solid black centre dot surrounded by exactly four concentric coloured rings, drawn as flat bands of uniform colour. It is the only object with a black centre dot. Every other mark - the grey rule ticks, the pale plates, the pale label blocks and the pale pip-less rings - is decoration and carries no information. Number the four rings of the core button 1 to 4 outwards from the black dot. A ring's thickness is its radial width, the distance from its inner edge to its outer edge. A ring's darkness is the darkness of its own flat fill colour. Exactly one ring is the thickest and exactly one ring is the darkest, and in this picture they are never the same ring. Is the thickest ring nearer the black centre dot than the darkest ring, or farther from it? Answer with one word: nearer or farther.
